description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter widget 'TagsPage' that provides a UI for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tags within the application. It interacts with repositories for tags and tasks, manages navigation to forms, displays loading states, empty states, and contextual menus, and handles user confirmation for deletions.

classes.name: TagsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of tags, allowing creation, editing, and deletion with user interactions.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage for creating a new tag.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage for editing an existing tag.

methods.name: _showTagMenu
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet with options to edit or delete a selected tag.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Prompts the user to confirm deletion of a tag, and if confirmed, removes the tag and updates affected tasks.
